segments.name: Core nutritional
segments.description: Develops and manufactures science-based nutritional, personal care and skincare products sold to Brand Partners and Preferred Customers worldwide.
segments.evidence: We organize our business into two reportable segments: Core nutritional and Hiya direct-to-consumer.

segments.name: Hiya direct-to-consumer
segments.description: Sells children's health and wellness products to U.S. customers primarily through a subscription model.
segments.evidence: Hiya operates and sells products to customers in the United States and, in 2026, is expanding into Canada and the United Kingdom.

revenueModel.text: Customers, including Brand Partners, Preferred Customers and Hiya subscribers, pay USANA for nutritional and wellness products purchased for personal use or resale.
revenueModel.evidence: Preferred Customers purchase our products strictly for personal use and are not permitted to resell or to distribute the products.

changes.text: In 2022, USANA acquired Rise and Oola, which are reported in the other category alongside the core nutritional segment.
changes.evidence: The other category is comprised of Rise Bar Wellness, Inc. ("Rise") and Oola Global, LLC ("Oola"), which are both businesses we acquired in 2022.
